summary: ENERGY VENTURES II AS (org. no. 987 960 981) is a private limited company (AS) based in Stavanger, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2005-03-05. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 00.000 (Uoppgitt); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) net income was -NOK 72 771. CEO: Helge Tveit; board chair: Helge Festøy Hellebust; auditor: PRICEWATERHOUSECOOPERS AS.
